user.title: Add a gauge station
user.description: How would you like to find the station?

river.title: Choose a river
river.description: Pick the river or catchment the gauge is on.

data_description.group: The river or catchment the gauge is on, as listed on waterlevel.ie.

select_station.title: Choose a station
select_station.description: Gauge stations on the {river_name}. Stations you have already added are not listed.

data_description.station: The gauge station to add. Each station becomes its own device.

station_number.description: Enter the station number (for example {example}) or paste the station's page address. You can look stations up at {stations_url}

data_description.station: The number shown on the station's waterlevel.ie page, or the page's address.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach waterlevel.ie. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_station: That doesn't look like a station number. Enter digits only, or paste the station's page address.
error.station_not_found: No sensor data found for that station. Check it exists on waterlevel.ie.
error.no_stations: No stations that you haven't already added were found on this river.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.cannot_load_rivers: Could not load the river list from waterlevel.ie. Try again later, or add the station by its number instead.

update_failed.message: Could not read any recent data for station {station} from waterlevel.ie: {error}
